text:
Ravi: Quick thread  priority: finalize benchmark launch microcopy + routing CSV for GrowthOps. Goal: publish 3 social posts + webinar landing. Need one-liners, preferred chart, and routing tag + priority. Keep copy factual and include eval-footnote.

Tess: One-liner: 'Lower per-token spend, same quality.' Chart: sparkline + small table. Routing: demand-gen, priority: warm.

Marco: One-liner: 'Maintain sub-200ms tail for interactive flows.' Chart: tail heatmap. Routing: product, priority: hot. Add note: link to dataset.

Elena: One-liner: 'Savings hit hard in high-throughput batch jobs.' Chart: stacked-bar (batch vs interactive). Routing: sales-ops, priority: hot. :moneybag:

Ravi: CopyBot will ingest captions for tone-check. Also need A/B subject lines for webinar and 2 CTA variants.

CopyBot: tone-scan-complete: suggestions: keep numbers rounded, include footnote link.

Ivy: I'll produce the CSV for GrowthOps. Template?

Ravi: Use fields: chart_type,caption,routing_tag,priority,cta_variant,footnote_link.

Ivy: CSV sample:```chart_type,caption,routing_tag,priority,cta_variant,footnote_link
sparkline,"Lower per-token spend, same quality.",demand-gen,warm,register,https://redwood.ai/bench/notes
heatmap,"Maintain sub-200ms tail for interactive flows.",product,hot,request-demo,https://redwood.ai/bench/notes
stacked_bar,"Savings hit hard in high-throughput batch jobs.",sales-ops,hot,contact-sales,https://redwood.ai/bench/notes```

Tess: Webinar hook: 'How to keep SLAs while cutting inference costs.' Follow blurb: 'We show the knobs, configs, and real numbers.'

Marco: Also add short social alt text for images for accessibility.

Elena: We'll schedule drafting session tomorrow morning to finalize visuals.

Ravi: Great. Ivy, can you drop CSV into /growthops/ingest today and ping Ops?

Ivy: Done: assets-uploaded: 1795003550  /growthops/ingest/1795/bench-routing.csv

Ravi: Thanks team. We'll review creative in the morning. :coffee:
